reindex.runningDescription: Re-indexing your past conversations for the upgraded AI model… {{done}}/{{total}}

apiKey.label: {{provider}} API Key
apiKey.removeConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove the {{provider}} API key?

defaultModel.title: Default Model for Chat
defaultModel.description: Primary model for new chats. Other configured models act as fallbacks.

fastMode.title: Fast Response Mode
fastMode.description: Super fast responses using the Codex CLI fast model, Groq, or Natively. Turn this off to use the selected normal model.
fastMode.requirement: Requires Groq, Natively API, or Codex CLI to be configured
fastMode.requirementSentence: Requires Groq, Natively API, or Codex CLI to be configured.
fastMode.configureFirst: Please configure Groq, Natively API, or Codex CLI first to enable Fast Response Mode.

cloud.title: Cloud Providers
cloud.description: Add API keys to unlock cloud AI models.

codexCli.title: Local Provider (Codex CLI)
codexCli.description: Route text and screenshot responses through a locally authenticated Codex CLI.
codexCli.enableHint: Adds Codex CLI as a selectable local backend and fallback.
codexCli.serviceTierHint: Use faster service tier if available. Codex Cloud only.
codexCli.reasoningEffortHint: How much reasoning effort the model uses. Model-dependent.

ollama.title: Local Models (Ollama)
ollama.runningNoModels: Ollama is running but no models found. Run `ollama pull llama3` to get started.

custom.title: Custom Providers
custom.description: Add your own AI endpoints via cURL.
custom.responsePathHint: Dot notation path to the answer text in the JSON response. If empty, the full JSON is returned.
custom.visionHint: Auto-detect enables vision when your cURL uses <0></0> or an OpenAI-style <1></1> body. Choose “Always” only if your endpoint accepts images another way; “Never” keeps this provider out of screenshot analysis.
custom.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this provider?

screenUnderstanding.title: Screen understanding
screenUnderstanding.description: Pick how Natively reads what is on your screen. All paths use the vision-capable AI provider directly; OCR is no longer used.
screenUnderstanding.visionFirstHint: Recommended. Try every configured vision provider in order; first success wins.
screenUnderstanding.visionOnlyHint: Stricter. Require a vision-capable provider; never silently drop the screenshot.
screenUnderstanding.privateVisionHint: Use a local vision model (Ollama) only. Never call cloud vision. Clear error if no local provider is configured.
screenUnderstanding.technicalInterviewHint: Use the highest-resolution image profile so code text stays sharp in interview mode.

dataScopes.title: Cloud provider data scopes
dataScopes.description: Control what data cloud AI providers can access. Disabled types are handled locally for privacy.
dataScopes.footnote: When a data type is disabled, Natively falls back to the best available local model to keep that data on-device.
